description:
## Scope

Pure data-type change. Add an optional CRL bundle to the harness Chain.

## What

Modify pkix-difftest/src/lib.rs:

- Add Chain.crls: Vec<Vec<u8>> (DER-encoded CRL bytes). Default empty.
- Update Chain::from_pem_file / from_pem_bytes signatures or add new constructors that accept CRL bytes. Two options:
  (a) Add optional 'crls' parameter to the loaders (breaking the existing test fixtures).
  (b) Add separate Chain::with_crls(self, crls: Vec<Vec<u8>>) -> Self builder.
  Recommend (b) — additive, keeps existing loaders working.
- Update Chain rustdoc to document the new field's purpose and the 'empty means skip revocation' contract.

## Out of scope

- Wiring the field through to any oracle (sibling beads).
- Loading CRLs from corpus fixtures (sibling beads).
- Baseline regeneration.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Chain.crls field present.
- [ ] Existing tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] At least one new unit test constructs a Chain with crls and inspects them.

## Parent

PKIX-emf1.
title: Extend pkix-difftest Chain struct with crls: Vec<Vec<u8>>
